Name: Sam Revised Hair Add-Ons
Author: Everbough
Description:
One of my favorite sprite mods is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12115/]Sam Revised Hair Portrait[/url], but I know it's missing some updated sprites and portraits for festivals and events besides the Flower Dance and seasons. This file has edited versions of all the various sprites with Sam's skater hair from the original mod.

THIS MOD REQUIRES [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]SEASONAL CUTE CHARACTERS[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12115/]SAM REVISED HAIR PORTRAIT[/url], AND [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]CONTENT PATCHER[/url] TO FUNCTION.

TO INSTALL:
1.) Navigate to your mod folder and the Seasonal Cute Characters folder.
2.) Open the zip file of this mod, and replace all of Sam's files within the Seasonal master folder with these. Make sure the locations of them match up correctly!
3.) Play as normal!

The portraits and sprites included in this mod are:
- The Egg Festival
- The Fair
- The Ice Festival
- The Luau
- Dance of the Moonlight Jellies
- Feast of the Winter Star
- Spirits Eve (Nothing should visually be different, but it is updated nonetheless)

THE MAIN SEASONAL OUTFITS ARE NOT INCLUDED IN THIS MOD.

All credit goes to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/141658958]lousianapurchase[/url], the original creator of this awesome mod. Please show them love!

Downloads.Description:
Replace Sam files in Seasonal Outfit's folder with all corresponding ones to work properly. Does not function on its own.

*Clean reupload to test installation issues.
